overview.about: The Cognizant Classic in The Palm Beaches - long known as the Honda Classic - is played on the Champion Course at PGA National in Florida. Its famous 'Bear Trap', a treacherous three-hole water-lined stretch, is one of the toughest closing runs on the PGA Tour.
overview.nextEvent: The next Cognizant Classic is played at PGA National Resort in Palm Beach Gardens. Wind off the Everglades and the Bear Trap's water hazards make it a stern test in the heart of the Florida swing.
